output_list.criticism: The contract lacks a proper access control mechanism, which is a critical aspect for managing sensitive operations like setting export fees, holding periods, and unlocking tokens.
The function allows anyone to set the export fee, which can lead to manipulation of fees and potentially unfair distribution of tokens.
The function allows anyone to set the holding period, which can lead to manipulation of the contract's behavior and unfair distribution of tokens.
The function allows anyone to unlock the token, which can lead to manipulation of the contract's behavior and unfair distribution of tokens.
The function exposes the fee calculation logic to anyone, which can lead to manipulation of fees and potentially unfair distribution of tokens.
